notes.title: Free Ghost Mode Update Available Now! Patch Notes for January 15th, 2024
notes.content:
As if this month wasn’t flying by fast enough already, we’re pleased to announce that the speedrunning platformer delight Mr. Run and Jump is ringing in the new year with an exciting content update that seriously ups the ante on replayability.

Today, Atari introduces an all-new game mode to the neon speedrunning hit: Ghost Mode. With this new feature, players can continuously improve their playtimes in any timed trial level by racing against a “ghost” avatar, essentially pitting players against themselves. 

After all, what’s a more satisfying achievement than conquering your best time?

In addition to the new gameplay mode, Mr. Run and Jump welcomes a content update providing level and enemy-specific balancing adjustments for an even smoother speedrunning experience. 

See full patch notes below:
[list]
[*] An all new time trial ghost feature has been added to the game! Achieving a new fastest time on any level's time trial will save a ghost recording of that run. Player's can now race against those ghost recordings upon replaying a time trial in order to improve their times.
[*] Balancing adjustments have been made to Mr. Run and Jump's hitbox.
[*] Balancing adjustments have been made to most enemy hitboxes.
[*] Small balancing adjustments have been made to several levels.
[*] Level in the Dark Realm now take fewer orbs to unlock. Only 100 orbs are need to unlock all Dark Realm levels instead of 120.
[/list]

notes.title: Mr. Run and Jump 2600 available for pre-order!
notes.content:
[h1]The first Atari produced cartridge in over 30 years![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/7d2d21adb5614aa1fabd6014cf1be8b4d96bba8d.png[/img]

Atari is returning to its roots with the 2600 version of Mr. Run and Jump! This adventure platformer marks a significant milestone in gaming history: Atari’s first official 2600 cartridge since 1990! This version is a simple yet challenging 2D platformer originally developed for the Atari 2600 video game console. While it was built to run on old hardware, Mr. Run and Jump is a brand new game designed to be approachable to all players. Enjoy the retro charm of classic console gaming with Mr. Run and Jump 2600!

This limited edition collectors item comes complete with game box and manual!

For more information and pre-order details visit [url=https://atari.com/products/mr-run-and-jump-2600-limited-edition]Atari.com[/url]

notes.title: Coming soon to an Atari 2600 near you!
notes.content:
[h1]The First New Atari Game on a 2600 Cartridge in 32 Years[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/661966c63c796f05510c954528887063658c9720.png[/img]

We're excited to share that the original Mr. Run and Jump will be available along side the modern version! The 2600 game is a simple yet challenging 2D platformer. While this limited edition version was built to run on old hardware, Mr. Run and Jump 2600 is a brand-new game designed to be approachable to all players. Leap, the dog, has begun wandering toward the Dark Realm, and if he ventures too far, he’ll never be able to find his way back! It’s up to Mr. Run and Jump to save his best friend before it’s too late!

Made in the United States with high-quality materials, each Mr. Run and Jump cartridge comes sealed with a high-quality box, a 2600 game cartridge, and an instruction manual. Cartridges are manufactured to exacting standards from all new parts and materials, with beveled edges to prevent pin damage, strong gold-plated connectors, and identical power draw to the originals.

Preorders for the collectible cartridges will open on atari.com on July 31, 2023, for $59.99. Additional distribution will be announced at a later date. [url=https://atari.com/products/mr-run-and-jump-2600-limited-edition]Sign up now[/url] to be the first to know when pre-orders open.

notes.title: Assistance Abound!
notes.content:
[h2]A bit of a doozy...[/h2]
Between one-hit deaths, precision jumps, and all these darn Skullkin everywhere, Mr. Run and Jump can be a very challenging game! That is why we implemented several features that are designed to give you, the player, a bit of assistance if you need it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/405f58c9cd267b30bf6ba70e3d548e02a9b5b70b.gif[/img]
[h2]Mr. Watch and Learn[/h2]
Introducing Mr. Watch and Learn, your friendly, one-eyed guide through the Realms of Color! Mr. Watch and Learn is equipped with the know-how needed to survive the many dangers of the Realms, and he's more than happy to show you the ropes! You can find Mr. Watch and Learn all throughout the game. Talk to him, and he'll describe how to use Mr. Run and Jump's many different acrobatic abilities. He can even display a ghosted-version of Mr. Run and Jump, to show you exactly what you need to do in order to get past those particularly tricky obstacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/4c2342a04796d9cc8effe1332dedd3490869b168.gif[/img]
[h2]Dynamic Assistance[/h2]
Colliding with an enemy will usually respawn you at the beginning of the last room you entered. When this happens enough times, the game can trigger a couple different, helpful pickups depending on the situation. These pickups are checkpoint flags and invincibility stars.

[h3]Checkpoint Flags[/h3]
Especially large rooms can have checkpoint flags appear in the middle of them. Collecting one of these means you will no longer respawn at the beginning of the room, but instead you'll respawn at the flag's location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/d1863497e18c900d9195bff161ed1a43a8922722.gif[/img]

[h3]Invincibility Stars[/h3]
Feeling stuck, like you just can't get past the next obstacle? Wishing you could just move through those spikes and get on with the rest of the level? No problem! After many respawns in a room, an invincibility star will appear. As the name suggests, collecting one of these will make Mr. Run and Jump invincible for several seconds, so you can walk right past whatever was causing you grief!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/b8a2265e072a266becde00dbb2c0190532dc79ea.gif[/img]

[h2]Scaling Options[/h2]
Do you love a challenge and dynamic assistance doesn't sound appealing to you? Or maybe you're new to platformers and you wish assistance would come a little sooner? Mr. Run and Jump provides players with 3 options to scale the frequency at which checkpoint flags and invincibility stars spawn in: frequently, infrequently, and never. Use these options to give yourself the gameplay experience that suites you best!

[h3]For more updates be sure to follow us on social media![/h3]

notes.title: Join us each Friday on Twitch!
notes.content:
[h1]Our stream schedule is live! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/b45f337fa773b366340125b95afd7ac6a973c0f4.gif[/img]
Join our stream each week, Friday at 5PM CT. Come hang out, learn more about Mr. Run and Jump, and meet the developers behind this dazzling neon platformer! 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/graphitelab]Follow Graphite Lab on Twitch[/url]

In future streams, we'll discuss the art style, the tools we used to make the game, and maybe even host some guest appearances by our buddies at Atari. 

Share the news - it helps us a lot! 

[h2]Missed last week's stream? [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/b923af90963928f308830095abfb39aaf79a4b2c.gif[/img]

You can get caught up by zipping over to our [url=https://m.twitch.tv/videos/1830091159]Twitch page[/url]. 

Last week we introduced [b]Game Director[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/JohnMikula]John Mikula[/url], and [b]Executive Producer[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/raitheoshow]Matt Raithel[/url]. Together, John and Matt dig into a bit of the history of Mr. Run and Jump and give a preview of the first level of Violet World. Did Matt break his record time on Violet World 1-1?! Watch the archive to find out! 

[url=https://m.twitch.tv/videos/1830091159]Watch last week's stream on Twitch![/url] 

[h1]The Worlds of Mr. Run and Jump[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/9f498f49a6674d2e4636d427e1cc180735a9c9a3.gif[/img]

Speaking of [i]violet world[/i], the worlds in Mr. Run and Jump are based on the colors of the rainbow. The player starts in the violet world and works their way up to red and beyond. Violet world will introduce the player to the core mechanics and various moves needed to get through each stage. As the player moves through the colors of the rainbow more difficult challenges and enemies must be met! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/34db13e9e470cb3ff463aa9eedc14e4e9792319c.gif[/img]
Survive Violet World and more difficult and colorful challenges await!

notes.title: Jumps, Orbs, and Hats!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/376f69c7eed78974d5e0301ceb8bd8acb008ad3e.gif[/img]
[h3]Mr. Run and Jump is about more than simply running and jumping.[/h3]
You can also:
[list]
[*]Double jump
[*]Wall jump
[*]Long jump
[*]High jump
[*]Dive
[*]Roll
[*]Crouch
[*]Bounce
[/list]
All of these moves are performed using only two buttons: a "jump" button and a "crouch" button. Plus, these actions can be chained together, almost like a jump-combo system. The right chain of jumps at the right time will keep you in the air for a preposterously long time, and it can feel like Mr. Run and Jump has learned how to fly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/aafd23f13598cccdf2232cb3eb72fb16218ea5ed.gif[/img]

[h3]There are three types of collectibles in Mr. Run and Jump.[/h3]
[list]
[*]Challenge Orbs - hidden within challenge rooms, challenge orbs are tough to acquire! Collecting all three in a level represents a significant challenge compared to the rest of the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/cc0ba93b3b248d01bab2d06dcdfd4c3b27c98c73.gif[/img]

[*]Shards - shards are scattered everywhere! They can be hidden among the scenery, they can highlight difficult jumps, and they can be gated behind mini challenges. When all the shards in a level are collected, they're assembled into their original form: a [i]shattered[/i] orb!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/00a7cdf585aec4e68bc5dfefb8765ce00e9943bc.gif[/img]

[*]Time Orbs - a level's time trial is unlocked after completing the level for the first time. Finishing the time trial with a fast enough time will unlock a time orb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/b923af90963928f308830095abfb39aaf79a4b2c.gif[/img]
[/list]
This Twitter thread gives a little more insight on how we used these collectibles to modify the player experience: https://twitter.com/JohnMikula/status/1656347844704452608


[h3]What can you do with all these orbs you're collecting?[/h3]
The orbs are used to unlock hats for Mr. Run and Jump! With a dozen hats to unlock and a few different honorific options, you can really give the game a face lift!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/a09d4fd904a3b8a9b0b7f1e489a92425afa38d1d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Mr. Run and Jump!
notes.content:
[h1]Mr Run and Jump draws you in with precise level design, free-flowing gameplay, and formidable challenge![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083365/577a32dcef18e8c2dd17aadf2bf48823743532c8.gif[/img]

[h3]Here's a bit more about what to expect: [/h3]

[b]Silky controls[/b] encourage players to run, jump, dash, double jump, and roll to clear levels with style, making it a speedrunner’s dream. 

[b]Collectibles [/b]hidden in tough-to-reach spots demand players use their wits as well as their dexterity. 

[b]Dynamic Assistance [/b]options allow players to set the level of difficulty they want. No matter how you play, Mr Run and Jump offers engaging gameplay options to players of varying skill levels and approaches.
